title: Contrapunctus IV

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the inverted subject in the soprano, on A.
☞ The answer in the alto, on D.
☞ The answer in the bass: all four voices are in.
☞ The subject in the soprano, on C.
☞ The subject in the bass, on F, its fifth note now leaping a third.
☞ Stretto: the tenor, then the bass a quarter note later.
☞ Stretto: the soprano a quarter note ahead of the alto.
☞ The last entry: the subject in the alto.

listenFor: the inverted subject; near the end, two strettos a quarter note apart
